title: Infinite scroll for precision work
summary: Endless automatic loading is a poor default when users need stable position, comparison, selection, completion, or repeatable navigation.
problem: Precision workflows lose page boundaries, footer access, and reliable return position.
use_when: Auditing admin, search, review, or bulk-action interfaces with endless scrolling
avoid_when: The task is intentionally open-ended browsing and position or completion do not matter
rationale: Discovery and task work have different navigation requirements.
Navigation mechanics should support the user's stopping rule.

signals: infinite scroll used in bulk-management table
back navigation loses prior scroll or result position
